# Cloudflare interaction inventory

Entire Cloudflare dashboard, including account and other products

Source completeness: **false**. This is a snapshot of ongoing exploration, not a claim of full dashboard coverage.

Counts are discovered-control occurrences, not unique controls. Shared navigation repeats across parent states. Pending reconciliation remains unresolved: no pending occurrence is inferred complete from another occurrence.

| Recorded status | Discovered-control occurrences |
| --- | ---: |
| blocked | 100 |
| explored and captured | 162 |
| not executed | 14 |
| pending | 19757 |

162 screenshot references resolve to imported package images; 0 refer to raw evidence not yet imported.

Pending controls remain unexercised in their recorded parent state. Blocked and not executed rows retain their recorded reasons below. Missing statuses remain unspecified.

Regenerate from the repository root with `python3 systems/cloudflare/tools/build_interaction_inventory.py`. The external source is read once and never modified. JSON preserves every source field, with identifiers sanitized and screenshot import annotations added.
